• Chats marked “Legacy setting” still keep original LINE notifications; turn one on and then off to opt into the new full-mute behavior.
• Only chats that have received a message appear here.
• The system may briefly show an alert before Notify+ dismisses it.
• If Android has already hidden the notification content, Notify+ cannot see the chat name and therefore cannot guarantee blocking that notification.
• When original LINE notifications are kept, LINE’s global summary may still include a muted chat; Notify+ will not hide other chats’ summary to suppress it.
• If an avatar is missing or a chat is absent, its notification probably hasn't arrived or been captured yet.

Notify+ does not write a complete message history to its own files. Message data is held temporarily in process memory and passed to Android for display; notification history may retain it according to your system settings. Only chat names, categories, last-active times, switches, and avatars are saved to disk. The App has no network permission and uploads none of this data.

Why does it need notification access?
The app can only rebuild LINE notifications after NotificationListenerService reads their content.
Will the app upload my messages?
No. The app has no INTERNET permission, analytics, backend, or self-update feature.
What does replacing original notifications mean?
When enabled, the original LINE notification is hidden and only the rebuilt Notify+ notification remains. Opening or reading that message in the LINE app also dismisses the Notify+ notification.
What if quick replies do not send?
This is still being investigated during closed testing. Keep the notification and report the phone model, Android version, and LINE version.
Why does it say “Sensitive notification content hidden”?

On Android 15 and later, the system may remove sensitive content before Notify+ receives it, so the app cannot recover the original text. You can try turning off “Enhanced notifications” under Settings → Notifications → More settings, but this may not work on every OPPO or realme version and may also disable smart-reply features. If it only happens on the lock screen, you can allow lock-screen notification content and turn off “Smart notification hiding”; doing so reduces protection against people nearby reading notifications. When Notify+ recognizes Android’s standard placeholder, it keeps the original LINE notification and does not repost the placeholder.
Xiaomi: how to keep it running in the background?

1. Settings → Apps → Permissions → Autostart, enable Notify+
2. Apps → Notify+ → Battery saver → No restrictions
3. Turn off "Pause app activity if unused"
4. Restart the phone afterwards
OPPO: how to keep it running in the background?

1. Phone Manager → Privacy → Startup Manager → enable Notify+
2. Long-press the icon → Power usage → Allow background activity
3. In recents, pull down to lock Notify+
4. Fully close and reopen the app
vivo: how to keep it running in the background?

1. iManager → App Manager → Permissions → Autostart → enable Notify+
2. iManager → Battery → set to Normal mode
3. In recents, pull down to lock Notify+
4. Restart the app afterwards
Samsung: how to keep it running in the background?
1. Settings → Apps → Notify+ → Battery → Unrestricted\n2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits — keep Notify+ out of the sleeping list\n3. Disable "Put unused apps to sleep" for this app
Huawei: how to keep it running in the background?

1. Settings → Apps → Notify+ → Battery → switch to Manual manage; allow auto-launch and background activity\n2. Settings → Battery → App launch → set Notify+ to Manual (all on)\n3. Lock Notify+ in recents
When reporting, include the phone model, Android version, LINE version, notification style, and steps to reproduce. Do not paste private message content.
